# 论文 fixture

来源均为 arXiv q-bio 开放获取论文，直链可重复下载。此表是渲染/裁切固定回归样本，不表示每篇都适用于完整原创研究汇报流程：

| 文件 | 论文 | 下载 |
|---|---|---|
| `2605.13902.pdf` | A senescent-immune reserve niche model for incomplete lobular involution in the aging breast（摘要明确为 Review；全流程应拒绝，局部图源任务可用） | <https://arxiv.org/pdf/2605.13902> |
| `2510.07653.pdf` | Large-scale spatial variable gene atlas for spatial transcriptomics | <https://arxiv.org/pdf/2510.07653> |
| `2601.17669.pdf` | Quantitative cancer-immunity cycle modeling to optimize bevacizumab and atezolizumab combination therapy for advanced renal cell carcinoma | <https://arxiv.org/pdf/2601.17669> |
